status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; revised by issue #523 (ADR-0040); read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: scripts/contracts/contract.sh, header.
goal: A judgment of whether the build's tests meant to fail failed on the code without the implementation and passed on the code with it, and scores of the change on the project's security items. A re-score, given the previous evaluation, states which items it scored afresh and which it inherited.
procedure: docs/evaluation-system.md > Gate rubrics — GATE:HYPOTHESIS, GATE:PLAN, AUDIT, GATE:QUALITY > AUDIT

security_checklist.note: the target's checklist at the version security-checklist.sh status names (score=), written to a file in the record directory (git show <score>); not given when none is declared

evaluation.note: the evaluator, writing into the output directory its prompt names (Q7, revised 2026-10-26)

test_first.note: what the evaluator read, and whether it confirms that the tests meant to fail failed on the code without the implementation and passed on the code with it; when it does not, no scores are given

scores.note: the items scored by default; an invocation's instructions may disable an item or add one. Each value a number 0-10, or { score, reason }

rescore.note: on a re-score: the items scored afresh (rescored) and the items inherited (inherited), and what became of the previous evaluation's findings (prior_findings) — docs/evaluation-system.md > Evaluation Output Format

checks.note: Q2: the evaluation outputs scores and their grounds; the pass values travel in reference

failure.note: Written instead of the expected output when the run does not reach its goal: what the run did and why it did not reach the goal — an input it needed and was not given named as such. check-out then writes `failed` (docs/core.md > Development Lifecycle; ADR-0040 D1).

default: Nothing beyond its outputs: they are its result.
